en.instruksi: Read the title, then put the blood's journey in order, starting when the heart pumps.
en.tubuh-arteri: arteries carry blood around the body
en.tubuh-kapiler: capillaries: oxygen and nutrients pass into cells
en.tubuh-sisa: cells pass carbon dioxide into the blood
en.tubuh-vena: veins carry blood back to the heart
en.paru-pompa: the heart pumps blood to the lungs
en.paru-ambil: in the lungs blood drops carbon dioxide and picks up oxygen
en.paru-kembali: oxygen-rich blood returns to the heart
en.paru-ketubuh: the heart pumps it around the body
en.otak-arteri: arteries carry the blood to the brain
en.otak-kapiler: in the capillaries of the brain, oxygen and nutrients pass into the cells
en.otak-sisa: cells of the brain pass carbon dioxide into the blood
en.otak-vena: veins carry the blood back to the heart
en.kaki-arteri: arteries carry the blood to the leg muscles
en.kaki-kapiler: in the capillaries of the leg muscles, oxygen and nutrients pass into the cells
en.kaki-sisa: cells of the leg muscles pass carbon dioxide into the blood
en.kaki-vena: veins carry the blood back to the heart
en.lengan-arteri: arteries carry the blood to the arm muscles

en.lengan-sisa: cells of the arm muscles pass carbon dioxide into the blood
en.lengan-vena: veins carry the blood back to the heart
en.tangan-arteri: arteries carry the blood to the fingers
en.tangan-kapiler: in the capillaries of the fingers, oxygen and nutrients pass into the cells
en.tangan-sisa: cells of the fingers pass carbon dioxide into the blood
en.tangan-vena: veins carry the blood back to the heart
en.telinga-arteri: arteries carry the blood to the ears
en.telinga-kapiler: in the capillaries of the ears, oxygen and nutrients pass into the cells
en.telinga-sisa: cells of the ears pass carbon dioxide into the blood
en.telinga-vena: veins carry the blood back to the heart
en.lidah-arteri: arteries carry the blood to the tongue
en.lidah-kapiler: in the capillaries of the tongue, oxygen and nutrients pass into the cells
en.lidah-sisa: cells of the tongue pass carbon dioxide into the blood
en.lidah-vena: veins carry the blood back to the heart
en.hidung-arteri: arteries carry the blood to the nose
en.hidung-kapiler: in the capillaries of the nose, oxygen and nutrients pass into the cells
en.hidung-sisa: cells of the nose pass carbon dioxide into the blood
en.hidung-vena: veins carry the blood back to the heart
en.mata-arteri: arteries carry the blood to the eyes
en.mata-kapiler: in the capillaries of the eyes, oxygen and nutrients pass into the cells
en.mata-sisa: cells of the eyes pass carbon dioxide into the blood
en.mata-vena: veins carry the blood back to the heart
en.parupanjang-arteri: the pulmonary artery carries it to the lungs
en.parupanjang-tukar: in the lung capillaries, carbon dioxide is let go and oxygen is picked up
en.parupanjang-venaparu: the pulmonary vein carries oxygen-rich blood
en.parupanjang-tiba: the blood arrives back at the heart
